correctness.rationale: Condition on target intent size S~Bin(m,p); eligible rows K~Bin(r-1,p^S). For S<m the target is the meet of other rows exactly if every missing attribute has an eligible zero; conditional chance (1-p^K)^(m-S). For S=m the empty meet is allowed (0^0=1). Inclusion-exclusion gives the second expression. In the window log E[K]=(-log p)√(mp(1-p))(a-Z_m)+o(√m), so for Z_m<a-ε Chernoff+union bounds make failure vanish, and for Z_m>a+ε Markov gives K=0 w.h.p.; CLT yields Φ(a). Independently summed all 2^(rm) complete binary matrices for (r,m,p)=(2,3,1/2),(3,3,2/3),(3,4,1/2), matching the conditional formula exactly; last case 831/4096. Finite checks do not prove the asymptotic.
